_doc: The central ccid release channel. Workflows rendered with render_schema = 2 read this file (the runner names its URL in CCID_CHANNEL_URL) and run the release it selects. `classes` overrides `default` per runs-on label (canary: change one class first). A bump is a commit to this file; a rollback is a revert. The release must be published in the corbet-cid generic package registry. `fleet` is fleet data (first-party owner prefixes and their legacy aliases) that checks with `fleet = true` read; an org move is an edit of this object.
